DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 橋へ向かう道は、今日は通行止めになっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The road leading to the bridge is closed today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 橋の向こうで友人と会う約束です。別の道で行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 閉鎖された橋の先で待ち合わせていると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I arranged to meet a friend on the other side of the bridge. Can I get there by another route?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are meeting someone beyond the closed bridge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 遠回りの道はありますが、ここからは距離があります。お友達はもう到着されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a detour, but it is quite a distance from here. Has your friend already arrived?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ駅です。道に詳しくないので、別の場所に変えたほうがよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人はまだ駅にいて待ち合わせ変更が可能だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are still at the station. They do not know the roads well, so it would probably be better to change the meeting place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that your friend is still at the station, so you can change the meeting place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら、今いる入口の案内板を待ち合わせ場所にしてはいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, how about meeting at the information board by this entrance, where we are now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入口が二つありますね。この入口の名前は案内図のどこに書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二つの入口を区別するため現在の入口名の表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are two entrances, aren't there? Where on the map is the name of this entrance written?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where the current entrance's name is shown so you can distinguish the two entrances. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在地の印の横です。反対側の入口と区別して伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is next to the mark showing your current location. Make sure you distinguish it from the entrance on the opposite side when you tell your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前と案内板の写真を送ります。駅から来る道でも通行止めに当たりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真と入口名を送ると伝え駅からの経路の閉鎖有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will send the name and a photo of the information board. Will they encounter any road closures on the way from the station either?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will send a photo and the entrance name, and ask whether the route from the station has any closures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 駅からこの入口までの経路は、この図で確認できます。園内の橋は渡る必要がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check the route from the station to this entrance on this map. There is no need to cross the bridge inside the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 橋の予定をやめて、この入口で待つと友人に連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 橋へ行かず入口で待つと友人へ連絡すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will contact my friend and tell them we are dropping the plan to go to the bridge and that I will wait at this entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to contact your friend to say you will wait at the entrance instead of going to the bridge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内板の前では通路をふさがずお待ちください。では、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait in front of the information board without blocking the walkway. Now, if you will excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札の前で切符を見ていらっしゃいますね。何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: I see you are looking at your ticket in front of the ticket gates. Is something wrong?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 本当は一つ前で降りるつもりでしたが、乗り過ごしました。この切符のまま出られるのかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗り過ごしを申告して手持ちの切符の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I actually meant to get off one stop earlier, but I missed it. I do not know whether I can exit with this ticket as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you missed your stop and ask what to do with your current ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切符を拝見します。購入した駅と、降りる予定だった駅を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see your ticket. Please tell me the station where you bought it and the station where you intended to get off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 出発した駅はこちらのメモに書きました。降りる予定だった駅は切符の行き先と同じなので、差額を確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入駅と予定駅を示して運賃差額の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrote the station I departed from in this note. The station where I meant to get off is the destination on the ticket, so could you check the fare difference?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the purchase station and intended destination, and ask to have the fare difference checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この切符の扱いを窓口で確認しますね。この駅で降りますか、それとも戻りたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check at the counter how to handle this ticket. Will you get off at this station, or would you like to go back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 迎えに来る友人に連絡したところ、この駅まで来てくれるそうです。ここで降ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 迎えの変更を説明し現在の駅で降りると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I contacted the friend who is picking me up, and they said they would come to this station. I will get off here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the change in pickup arrangements and decide to get off at the current station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、この駅までの運賃で精算します。金額はこちらですが、お支払い方法も確認しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then we will adjust the fare for travel to this station. This is the amount; would you also like to check the payment methods?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 現金で払います。精算後に使う切符を、元の切符と間違えないよう教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現金払いを選び精算後に使う切符を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will pay in cash. Please show me which ticket to use after the adjustment so I do not confuse it with the original ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose cash payment and confirm which ticket to use after the fare adjustment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 元の切符はこちらで受け取り、精算済みの切符をお渡しします。改札にはこちらをお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will take the original ticket and give you a ticket showing the fare has been adjusted. Please use this one at the gate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この精算済みの切符で改札を通るのですね。友人には改札の外で待つと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 精算済み切符の使い方と友人との待合せ場所を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: So I should go through the gate with this adjusted-fare ticket. I will tell my friend I will wait outside the gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat how to use the adjusted-fare ticket and where you will meet your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、忘れ物がないかお確かめのうえ、お進みください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please make sure you have not left anything behind before proceeding. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 記入が止まっている欄は、どちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which field have you stopped at while filling this in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この世帯主という欄です。友人と同じ部屋に住んでいますが、友人の名前を書くのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同居する友人を世帯主欄に書くべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This field marked “head of household.” I live in the same room as a friend; should I write my friend's name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you should write the friend you live with in the head-of-household field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一緒に住んでいることだけでは判断できません。登録上の世帯がどうなっているか、担当者に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot determine that simply from the fact that you live together. Let's check with the staff member how your household is registered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 部屋の契約者は友人です。契約者と世帯主が同じとは限らない、ということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 部屋の契約者と世帯主の違いを確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend is the person named on the room's rental agreement. Does that mean the leaseholder and the head of household are not necessarily the same person?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the difference between the room's leaseholder and the head of household. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、賃貸の契約者と住民登録の世帯主は別の情報です。この欄は空けたまま窓口へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, the leaseholder and the head of household in resident registration are separate pieces of information. Please leave this field blank and take the form to the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、友人の名前を推測で書かずに相談します。住所の欄は部屋番号まで書いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 世帯主を推測で記入せず住所欄の書き方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will ask about it rather than guessing and writing my friend's name. May I include the room number in the address field?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not guess the head of household, and check how to fill in the address field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お住まいの住所と部屋番号をご記入ください。建物名も、書類にある表記と合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please enter your home address and room number. Let's also match the building name to the way it is written on your documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 契約書には建物名がカタカナで載っています。その表記を写して、窓口で確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 契約書の建物名の表記を用いて窓口で確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The building name is in katakana on the rental agreement. I will copy that spelling and have it checked at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will use the building name as written on the rental agreement and have it checked at the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それで結構です。世帯主については、相談したい点を担当者にもお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is fine. Please also explain to the staff member what you would like to ask about the head of household.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同じ部屋に住む友人との登録上の関係を確認したい、と伝えます。世帯主欄は今は空欄にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 世帯主欄を空け登録上の関係を担当者に相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will say I want to check my registered relationship with the friend who shares my room. I will leave the head-of-household field blank for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the head-of-household field blank and ask the staff member about your registered relationship. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、担当窓口へどうぞ。本日はお越しいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please go to the appropriate counter. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待合室の席について、何かお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need any help with seating in the waiting room?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 片耳が聞こえにくく、遠くから呼ばれると名前がわかりません。診察の順番を逃さないか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 片耳の聞こえにくさと呼出しを逃す心配を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have difficulty hearing in one ear, and I cannot make out my name when someone calls from a distance. I am worried I might miss my turn to see the doctor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your difficulty hearing in one ear and your worry about missing a call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前を確認しますので、受付票を見せてください。聞こえやすい側はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me your reception slip so I can check your name. Which side can you hear better on?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左側のほうが聞き取りやすいです。こちらが受付票で、名前はグエン・ミンです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 聞こえやすい側と受付票の氏名を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can hear more clearly on my left side. Here is my reception slip; my name is Nguyen Minh.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the side on which you hear better and the name on your reception slip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認しました。呼出しを担当する職員に、左側から近くで声をかけてほしいことを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have checked it. I will tell the staff member who calls patients that you would like them to speak close to you from your left side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 助かります。もし聞こえなかったときは、もう一度声をかけてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 呼出しが聞こえなければ繰り返してもらうよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: That would help. If I do not hear the call, could they call me again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to have the call repeated if you do not hear it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者にその希望も伝えます。今は案内しやすいこちらの席に移っていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass that request on too. For now, could you move to this seat, where it is easier for us to come and get you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらの席ですね。診察中も聞き返すことがありますので、先生にも伝えていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定の席を確認し診察時の聞き返しも医師へ伝えてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: This seat here, right? I may also need to ask for things to be repeated during the consultation, so I would like you to tell the doctor too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the designated seat and ask to have the doctor told you may need things repeated during the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診察時の希望も申し送ります。内容が聞き取れないときは、その場で知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass on your request for the consultation as well. If you cannot make out what is being said, please let us know at the time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わからないまま返事をせず、聞き取れなかった箇所を伝えます。ここで呼出しを待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 聞き取れない箇所を知らせながら指定席で待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not answer without understanding; I will say which part I could not hear. I will wait here to be called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait in the designated seat and point out anything you cannot hear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、私は担当者に連絡してきます。こちらでお待ちください、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will go and contact the staff member. Please wait here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾得物をお持ちいただいたのですね。何を拾われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought in a lost item, I see. What did you find?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鍵が三本付いたキーホルダーです。持ち主が困ると思って、届けに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三本の鍵が付いたキーホルダーを拾って届けたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A key ring with three keys on it. I thought the owner would be having trouble without it, so I came to hand it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you found and brought in a key ring with three keys. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。拾った場所と時間を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. Could you tell me where and when you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日の昼十二時ごろ、橋の東側の歩道で拾いました。交差点のすぐ手前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 鍵の発見時刻と橋の東側という場所を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I found it around noon today on the sidewalk east of the bridge, just before the intersection.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain when you found the keys and that the location was east of the bridge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 地図ではこのあたりでしょうか。橋の上か、橋を渡った先かも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would that be around here on the map? I would also like to check whether it was on the bridge or beyond it after crossing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 橋を渡った先です。橋の上ではなく、この街灯の下に落ちていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 橋を渡った先の街灯下と地図上の位置を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was beyond the bridge after crossing. It was not on the bridge; it was lying under this streetlight.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the location on the map to under the streetlight beyond the bridge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この位置ですね。鍵は拾ったときから、今の状態だったのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: This spot, then. Were the keys already in their current condition when you found them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、三本とも輪に付いていました。持ち主の名前は見当たらず、鍵を使ってみることもしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 拾得時の鍵の状態と使用していないことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, all three were attached to the ring. I could not find the owner's name, and I have not tried using the keys either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the keys' condition when you found them and say you have not used them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わかりました。お届けについての確認事項がありますので、ご希望も含めて順に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. There are some things to confirm about your report, so I will ask you about them in order, including your preferences.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 必要な確認はお願いします。もし持ち主から問い合わせがあった場合の連絡方法も説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 届出の確認に応じ持ち主からの問合せ時の連絡方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please go ahead with the necessary checks. Please also explain how contact will be handled if the owner makes an inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to the checks for the report and ask how contact will be handled if the owner inquires. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者からご説明します。届けてくださってありがとうございました、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff member in charge will explain. Thank you for bringing them in. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒ですね。宛名の数字が少しにじんでいるので、発送前に確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the envelope, then. The numbers in the address have run a little, so let me check them before it is sent.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 雨がかかったようです。中の書類は濡れていませんが、住所の番地が読みにくくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 封筒の番地が雨でにじんだが中身は乾いていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It seems rain got on it. The documents inside are not wet, but the street address numbers have become hard to read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that rain blurred the address numbers on the envelope, but the contents are dry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 正しい住所がわかるものをお持ちですか。数字を推測で書き足さず、確認してから直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have anything showing the correct address? Let's check before correcting it, rather than guessing and adding numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 提出先から届いた案内メールがあります。そこには二丁目十五番六号と書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内メールを参照して正しい番地を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have an information email from the office I am submitting these to. It says 2-chome, 15-ban, 6-go.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Refer to the information email and give the correct address numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、その表記を使って書き直してください。今の封筒を使うか、別の封筒に替えるかはどうなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then please rewrite it using that notation. Would you like to use the current envelope or replace it with another one?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 濡れた跡もあるので、新しい封筒に移します。書類を入れ直す場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新しい封筒への交換を決め書類を入れ直す場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are water marks too, so I will transfer the documents to a new envelope. Is there somewhere I can put them into it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to switch to a new envelope and ask where you can transfer the documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの記入台をお使いください。中身を置いたまま離れないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please use this writing counter. Please do not leave the contents unattended.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで入れ替えます。差出人の住所も、旧封筒と同じように書けばよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記入台で移し替え差出人住所の記載を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will transfer them here. I should write the sender's address just as it is on the old envelope too, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will transfer the contents at the writing counter and confirm how to write the sender's address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、ご自身の現在の住所をご記入ください。書き終えたら宛先をもう一度確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please enter your own current address. Once you finish writing, let's check the destination again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい封筒に入れ、メールの住所と照合しました。古い封筒は持ち帰りますので、新しいほうの受付をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛先を照合した新封筒の受付を頼み旧封筒を持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I put them in the new envelope and checked the address against the email. I will take the old envelope home, so please accept the new one for mailing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to have the new envelope accepted after checking its destination, and say you will take the old one home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 新しい封筒をお預かりしました。お忘れ物にお気をつけて、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have accepted the new envelope. Please take care not to leave anything behind. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日は口座について、どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss about your account today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 銀行のアプリを入れている携帯電話をなくしました。口座に関する対応を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 銀行アプリ入りの電話を紛失したと窓口で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost the mobile phone that has the bank's app installed. I would like to ask what needs to be done concerning my account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tell the counter staff you lost a phone with the banking app installed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当者が状況を確認します。今、その電話をご自身で操作できる状態ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The staff member in charge will check the situation. You are currently unable to operate that phone yourself, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、昨日の夜から見つかりません。アプリに入れるかどうかも、私には確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電話を操作できずアプリの状態も不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I have not been able to find it since last night. I cannot even check whether the app can be accessed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot operate the phone and do not know the app's status either. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当者へおつなぎします。まずご本人の確認に使える書類を拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will put you in touch with the staff member in charge. First, may I see a document that can be used to verify your identity?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 在留カードを持っています。別の電話番号へ変える予定ですが、先に紛失の相談を進められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人確認書類を提示し番号変更前に紛失の相談を進められるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my residence card. I plan to change to another phone number, but can we proceed with discussing the loss first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Present an identity document and ask whether you can discuss the loss before changing your number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番号変更と紛失時の対応は、担当者がそれぞれ確認します。新しい番号はもうお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will check the number change and the response to the loss separately. Have you already decided on your new number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ決まっていません。確認できていない番号を申込書に書くのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新しい電話番号が未定なので推測で記入しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I would like to avoid writing an unconfirmed number on the application form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your new phone number is undecided, so you will not guess and enter one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そうですね、未定と担当者にお伝えください。今後の連絡方法も相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Quite right. Please tell the staff member it is undecided. Let's also discuss how to contact you from now on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 勤務中は連絡を受けにくいので、連絡できる時間も伝えます。まず担当者の説明を聞かせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡可能時間を伝えたうえで担当者の説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is difficult for me to receive communications while working, so I will also tell them what times I can be contacted. First, please let me hear the staff member's explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your available contact times and say you would like the staff member's explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者がこちらへ参ります。ご相談ありがとうございました、私はこれで失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff member is coming over here. Thank you for speaking with me; I will leave you now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お買い物袋についてのお問い合わせでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your inquiry about a shopping bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋を二つに分けたのに、出口で一つしか持っていないと気づきました。袋詰めの台に置き忘れたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出口で袋が一つ足りず袋詰め台への置忘れを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I divided my purchases into two bags, but at the exit I realized I only had one. I might have left one at the bagging counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you noticed a bag missing at the exit and may have left it at the bagging counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの台を使われましたか。残っている袋には何が入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which counter did you use? What is in the bag you still have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 窓側の二番の台です。手元には野菜があり、見つからないほうには洗剤と歯ブラシを入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 利用した台と残った袋・失くした袋の内容を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Counter number two by the window. I have the vegetables with me; I put detergent and a toothbrush in the missing bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the counter you used and the contents of the remaining and missing bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その台で袋を一つ預かっています。中身の確認のため、レシートを見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We are holding a bag found at that counter. Could you show me your receipt so we can check the contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このレシートに洗剤と歯ブラシが載っています。袋の持ち手には、私が青いリボンを結んであります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入記録と袋の青いリボンを示して自分の袋と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: This receipt lists detergent and a toothbrush. I also tied a blue ribbon to the bag's handle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use the purchase record and the bag's blue ribbon to identify it as your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: リボンも一致していますね。お預かりした袋をお渡ししますので、中身をお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The ribbon matches too. I will return the bag we have been holding; please check the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: どちらの商品もあります。レシートを残しておいたので、確認していただけてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返された袋の二商品がそろっていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Both items are here. I am glad I kept the receipt so you could check them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that both items are present in the returned bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見つかってよかったです。袋が二つあると、持ち替えたときに忘れやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I am glad it was found. With two bags, it is easy to forget one when you shift them between your hands.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今度は二つの持ち手をまとめて持ちます。今日は袋を預かってくださり、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再発防止の持ち方を伝えて保管へのお礼を言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: This time I will hold both handles together. Thank you for keeping the bag for me today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain how you will carry the bags to prevent a recurrence and thank the staff for keeping it safe. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二袋そろいましたね。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have both bags now. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 植込みの近くで立ち止まっていましたね。どうされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: I noticed you stopped near the planted area. What happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どものボールが植込みの奥へ転がりました。立入禁止とあるので、入らずに相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ボールが立入禁止の植込みへ入り中へ入らず相談したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child's ball rolled deep into the planted area. The sign says “No entry,” so I came to ask for help without going in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the ball went into the off-limits planted area and you came to ask without entering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入らずにいてくださってありがとうございます。ボールは見える位置にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for staying out. Is the ball somewhere you can see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 赤いボールが、あの木の根元に見えます。枝の向こうなので、ここからは手が届きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 赤いボールの位置と手が届かない状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can see the red ball at the base of that tree. It is beyond the branches, so I cannot reach it from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the red ball's location and explain that you cannot reach it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 職員が状況を見ます。お子さんは今どちらにいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: A staff member will look at the situation. Where is your child now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベンチで家族と待っています。取りに行こうとしないよう、家族にも伝えてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子どもの待機場所と植込みへ入らないよう伝えたことを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Waiting with family on a bench. I have also told my family not to try to go and retrieve it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report where the child is waiting and that you have told the family not to enter the planted area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、そのままお待ちください。植込みを踏まずに回収できるか、別の職員と確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please keep waiting there. I will check with another staff member whether we can retrieve it without stepping on the planted area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: すぐに取れなくても大丈夫です。子どもには待つ理由を説明し、入口近くのベンチにいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 回収を急がせず入口近くのベンチで待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is all right if you cannot get it immediately. I will explain to my child why we are waiting, and we will be on the bench near the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not rush the retrieval; say you will wait on the bench near the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ベンチはこちらですね。回収について確認できたらお声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the bench, right? We will come and speak to you once we have checked about retrieving it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、赤いボールを探している家族だとわかるよう、ベンチから動かずに待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 職員が家族を見つけやすいよう指定ベンチで待機すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, we will stay on the bench and wait so you can recognize us as the family looking for the red ball.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will wait at the designated bench so staff can easily find your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。私は確認に行ってきます、それでは少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will go and check, so please wait a little.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 経路の画面を何度か見直していらっしゃいますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: I see you have checked the route screen several times.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人は「橋本で降りて」と言っていますが、検索には別の県の橋本駅が出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同名駅が別の県に検索されたことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend told me to get off at Hashimoto, but the search shows Hashimoto Station in another prefecture.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the search returned a station with the same name in another prefecture. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ名前の駅があるので、都道府県も指定して検索してみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are stations with the same name, so let's try searching with the prefecture specified as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人の家は和歌山県ですから、和歌山県の橋本駅で調べ直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の所在地に合わせ県名付きで目的駅を調べ直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend's house is in Wakayama Prefecture, so I will search again for Hashimoto Station in Wakayama Prefecture.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Search again for the destination station with the prefecture name matching your friend's location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの結果なら、県内の駅が目的地になっています。待ち合わせは何時ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this result, the destination is a station within the prefecture. What time are you meeting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四時ですが、友人が駅まで迎えに来るので、着く時刻を先に知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 迎えに来る友人へ到着時刻を知らせたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: At four, but my friend is coming to the station to pick me up, so I would like to tell them my arrival time in advance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to tell the friend picking you up what time you will arrive. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この結果の到着時刻を伝えられますね。乗換駅も画面に出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can tell them the arrival time in this result. The transfer station is also shown on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 途中で一本見送った場合は、到着時刻をもう一度調べて連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 列車を見送った場合は到着時刻を再検索すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I let a train go without boarding along the way, I will check the arrival time again and contact them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will search for the arrival time again if you let a train go. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、実際に乗る列車の表示を確かめてから、友人に知らせると確実です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, it is more reliable to check the display for the train you actually board before telling your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅名だけで決めず、県名と列車の行き先も確認してから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 県名と列車の行き先も確かめて乗ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not decide based on the station name alone; I will also check the prefecture and the train's destination before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the prefecture and the train's destination before boarding as well. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 目的地がわかってよかったですね。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am glad you have identified your destination. Have a good trip.
